scope: Independent source-and-gold adjudication of SQL construction findings only. Finding events were read from results/e01..e04/collection.json. Costs, event logs, and efficiency outcomes were not inspected or used.
method: For each run, compare each submitted finding with the mapped task evaluator/gold.json dangerous execution path and the raw/Serene source and contracts. A finding is correct when its location identifies the dangerous execution site or an explicitly traced helper-origin site and its mechanism establishes untrusted input reaching SQL syntax. Findings about safe finite ordering maps, fixed parameterized queries, or wrapper follow-through without a dangerous construction would be false alarms if present.

limitations: This is not fully arm-blinded: the frozen run mapping and arm labels were available, and the source packet identities expose raw versus Serene variants.
The adjudication is source/gold classification only; it does not assess investigation cost, timing, event traces, or efficiency.
Only submitted finding_events were adjudicated. Additional-review dispositions and unsubmitted reasoning were not treated as findings.
Task golds define one dangerous construction path per task; this adjudication does not expand the gold set or make claims about defects outside the construction-only oracle.
